fact: An Auditor-General IT audit of GIFMIS and IPPIS, as at November 2020, found no business continuity and disaster recovery policy for the GIFMIS data centre; the Accountant-General's office said a contracted continuity plan was yet to be activated.
title: Audit uncovers how flawed IPPIS, GIFMIS are costing govt. multi-billion Naira losses
